name: Vincenzo Maria Fontana
source:
They call him "The Abomination." According to the locals, he's committed the unforgivable act of fusing his flesh with that of an eldritch abomination. Although you don't trust him, you believe he can uncover the town's secrets.

[From [url=https://brokemycrown.itch.io/reanimated-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
